name: triangle
summary: Draws a CSS triangle out of borders, pointing in a given direction.

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end, which follow the writing direction

arguments.name: $color
accepts: a Sass colour, such as red, #333 or oklch(70% 0.1 200)
a system colour such as Canvas
var(), color-mix(), light-dark(), contrast-color() or rgb(from ...), which CSS resolves
a CSS-wide keyword is refused, because it is invalid inside the border-color shorthand

arguments.name: $size
accepts: one length, or two lengths as width then height
var(), env() or a calculation in place of any length
